title: 下个世纪增长最快：印度被点名押注，税制辩论能定调吗？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Before we continue, let me also thank Prime Minister Modi and his government for their partnership to bring the Forum to India.
segments.zh: 在继续之前，我也感谢莫迪总理及其政府合作，将论坛带到印度。

segments.en: Power to succeed is ahead. Power to help others succeed.
segments.zh: 成功的力量在前方。帮助他人成功的力量。

segments.en: So, today I am with this vision.
segments.zh: 所以，今天我带着这个愿景。

segments.en: This is a place when we look over the next century that I think will grow faster than any other major economy in the world having access to that raw intelligence to power your future
segments.zh: 展望下个世纪，我认为这里将比世界上任何主要经济体增长更快，能够获取原始智能来驱动你的未来

segments.en: I think is the thing that you can bet on.
segments.zh: 我认为这是你可以押注的事情。

segments.en: Debate on the transaction securities transaction tax.
segments.zh: 关于交易证券交易税的辩论。

segments.en: It's healthy to have this debate and I will be keen to be hearing them.
segments.zh: 进行这场辩论是健康的，我渴望听到他们的意见。

segments.en: If you're living with higher yields because of higher growth, to mean that's a good thing.
segments.zh: 如果你因为更高增长而面对更高收益率，那意味着这是好事。

segments.en: What do you think in your wildest dreams? AI will help us discover that we can't even imagine it.
segments.zh: 在你最疯狂的梦想中，你认为AI会帮助我们发现有想象力都想不到的东西吗？

segments.en: It's a tricky question because I think the answer is everything.
segments.zh: 这个问题不好回答，因为我认为答案涵盖方方面面。
